title: OrgTree Device Plane Dispositions (Model C)
description: Per-disposition routing for the device-plane writer: maps ComputerDisposition values to {entra, arm, skip} planes. Companion to ADR-038 (device-plane OrgPath) and ADR-084. Under Model C each device write is per-facet (10 attributes) rather than a single composite string.

plane.description: Routing target: entra=Graph PATCH on extensionAttribute*, arm=ARM PATCH on tags.*, skip=no write.

transport.description: Optional: 'Microsoft Graph' or 'Azure Resource Manager'. Informational.

target_resource_type.description: Optional: Graph endpoint or ARM resource type (e.g., directoryObject/device, Microsoft.HybridCompute/machines).
